# docs.archive.2026-06-30 — Historical operational docs

These operational docs are preserved for historical reference. The
project consolidated onto `ios-native/` (Swift / SwiftUI) on 2026-06-30
and the React Native app (`hydrolyze-mobile/`) was deleted.

**Do not edit these files.** They describe operational context that
no longer applies.

## What's in here

| File | Era | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `COACH-FLOW.md` | RN era | Tab-based mobile app workflow design from April 2026. RN app is gone. The iOS-native app follows a similar three-tab structure (Today, Workouts, Swimmers) but the navigation stack, auth flow, and screens are different. |
| `drop-all.sql` | RN era | "Drop all tables" nuclear script. Use with extreme caution — and only against a dev Supabase instance, never production. |
